errata.error: CO-OPS's verified 6-minute water levels carry the limit flag (L, an expected maximum or minimum height exceeded) on ordinary values at some stations, from an acquisition check against limits that are stale there. In March 2010 it is set on 4,142 of Annapolis's (8575512) 7,440 verified values and 2,210 of the Battery's (8518750), nearly all inside the month's own 1 to 99% range, and on none of Baltimore's (8574680), San Francisco's (9414290) or Key West's (8724580).
errata.response: On a verified 6-minute value L alone doesn't make it `suspect`; flat (F) and rate-of-change (R) still do, and L still does on preliminary values and on hourly heights and high and low waters. Years written before this rule keep verified L values as `suspect` until a backfill with `--refetch` reads them again.
errata.evidence: Found November 2026 by crowd-depth's lake reader, which saw Tolchester Beach (8573364) lose 212 days of 2012 to `suspect` at levels of −0.09 to +0.57 m MLLW, and confirmed by counting L in the verified values of March 2010, 2015 and 2020 at seven stations from CO-OPS's API with `datum=MLLW`: Tolchester Beach (8573364), Baltimore (8574680), Annapolis (8575512), Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel (8638610), the Battery (8518750), San Francisco (9414290) and Key West (8724580). Where L is set, at Tolchester, Annapolis, the Battery and the Bridge Tunnel, nearly every flagged value sits inside the month's own 1 to 99% range, and the count changes from year to year (Annapolis 4,142 in March 2010, none in March 2020).
